shell_commands: git status && git log --oneline -8 && git log --oneline origin/main -3
ls scripts/spec-links/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---CHANGELOG---"; cat CHANGELOG.md; echo "---test-commands---"; cat .lore/test-commands.yml 2>/dev/null
git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat && echo "=== spec diff ===" && git diff origin/main...HEAD -- specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
git diff origin/main...HEAD -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.ts src/types/ai.ts src/index.ts
sed -n '1,60p' src/orchestration/orchestratorHelpers.test.ts && echo "=== chatOrchestrator.ts L148-158 ===" && sed -n '145,160p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
cat scripts/check-changelog.sh; echo "=== spec-links check ==="; sed -n '1,60p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs

grep -n "export" node_modules/@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/rules/lib/spec-link-index.mjs | head; echo "=== signature of buildLinkIndex/readSpecFiles ==="; grep -n "function buildLinkIndex\|function readSpecFiles\|specsRoot\|roots" node_modules/@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/rules/lib/spec-link-index.mjs | head -20
grep -rn "specs/" src/config.test.ts | head -5; echo "=== test-commands.yml ==="; head -40 .lore/test-commands.yml; echo "=== tests.list? ==="; ls .lore/
grep -n "retention decision remains yours" CHANGELOG.md && sed -n '/### Fixed/,+3p' CHANGELOG.md | head -5
git add CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git status --short && git diff --cached --stat

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
docs(orchestrator): changelog and cite usage-gap test

Cite the reported-gaps acceptance test from the hooks spec so
re-lint/require-spec-link stops flagging it, record the rejected
total-plus-breakdown shape in the spec, and add the Unreleased
Changed entry stating what an existing consumer will now record.
Tick the dod facets the passing CI build closed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git log --oneline -2
git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/main HEAD && echo "ALREADY UP TO DATE WITH MAIN" || echo "NEEDS MERGE"
